title: Gis Map Dual Build Tiles
description: Add two GIS map play build targets: one that bundles prefetched OSM/vector tiles into dist for offline static hosting, and one that keeps runtime tile fetching via the dev proxy.
summary: Added two GIS map play build modes. `build` sets `GIS_MAP_TILE_SERVE_MODE=fetch` so Vite keeps the OSM/vector tile proxies that fetch missing tiles at dev/preview runtime. `build-tiles` prefetches raster/vector tiles (same flags as `tiles`), then builds with `GIS_MAP_TILE_SERVE_MODE=bundle`, copying `.repo-cache` tiles into `dist/osm` and `dist/vt` for offline static hosting. Introduced `GisMapTileServeMode`, `gisMapTilesVitePlugins`, and `resolveGisMapTileServeMode` in `ui/styling/vite-elements-assets.ts`. Registered nx targets, package scripts, and launch.json entries `📦build🌐gis📍map` and `📦build🌐gis📍map🧩tiles`. Verified fetch build omits tile dirs; bundle build copies z0 tiles into dist.
